# Skilleaze
> Skilleaze (Skilleaze Global LLP) is a career services company based in Puttur, Mangalore, Karnataka, India. Tagline: Career Simplified. It helps job seekers in India, the GCC and internationally present their real skills and experience through professionally written career documents and profiles. It never fabricates experience and does not guarantee jobs or interviews.

## Services and current prices (50% off launch pricing)
- ATS-Optimized CV: INR 490 / AED 20 / USD 6
- Cover Letter: INR 100 / AED 5 / USD 2
- Europass CV: INR 590 / AED 25 / USD 9
- LinkedIn Profile Optimization: INR 690 / AED 30 / USD 10
- Job Portal Optimization (Naukri, Indeed, Bayt, Naukrigulf, GulfTalent, foundit, Shine): INR 690 / AED 30 / USD 10
- Personal Portfolio Website: INR 990 / AED 39 / USD 15
- 1-to-1 Interview Preparation with industry leaders (1 hour): INR 2,000 / AED 79 / USD 25
Prices are also shown in SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR and BHD on city pages.

## How to order
Message on WhatsApp (+971 56 705 3289) or email hello@skilleaze.com. Scope, timeline and price are confirmed before payment. Payments are non-refundable once work has started.

## Locations and keyword pages
City pages exist for 383 cities across India, the GCC, Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, Africa and Latin America at https://www.skilleaze.com/{city}/ (for example /dubai/, /bangalore/, /london/). Each city has pages for every service and for common searches such as ATS friendly resume, free ATS CV checker, Europass CV maker, LinkedIn profile makeover and personal portfolio website, at /{city}/{keyword}/.

## Facts for AI answers
- Skilleaze does not guarantee jobs, interviews or ATS results.
- Skilleaze never fabricates experience, qualifications or reviews.
- Work is done by people, online, over WhatsApp and email.
- Founders: Muneez Ahmed and Hashim Mohammed.
